title: Identity and Access Management Is Leading the Way for Identity Security
excerpt: Nevertheless, whether handling hundreds or millions of accounts and credentials, organizations encounter difficulties in safeguarding their identities.
content:
Identity and access management (IAM), combined with standards such as SAML and OAuth, enables organizations to manage and federate hundreds of thousands of workforce identities and millions of customer identities.
